discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 242/266; reuses their keys. Holds released: Pastel (Pulse per-design Mini Pastel listings), Floral S1 Ariel, Floral S2 (per-pin size + 200 each), Jasmine & Rapunzel Window (per-pin size/listing). Rescuers in Flight characters found. Joy edition 300. Holds kept: Pixar mystery w1/w2, Neo Nouveau S2 Cinderella/Belle/Tiana. New 2021-2022 releases: Bruni/Flit/Hei Hei, Vasilovich Dragon + Maleficent Dragon on Glass, Pongo and Pugs, Ben Harman Framed S1, Ben Harman 101 Dalmatians/Aristocats, Ben Harman Alice/Princess and the Frog, Seven Dwarfs, Disney Castle series, Pixar UP, Maleficent Dragon and Castle. 29 searches.
